CustomField.description: Computed from the linked Form Template Page's Position. Used by the stages-list LWC to render in admin-defined order. No trigger needed to keep in sync — the formula re-evaluates when admins reorder pages.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Mirrors the linked page's Position so the stages overview renders in the admin-defined order. Reorder pages on the Form Template — this field updates automatically; no trigger needed.
CustomField.label: Sort Order
